info.name: Bakkt Crypto Solutions Accounts Jurisdictions API

items.docs: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of supported jurisdictions and any trading restrictions in place.

params.name: country
params.description: Country to query for. Lowest priority.

params.name: state
params.description: State to query for. Prioritized over country.

params.name: currency
params.description: Deprecated, use tradingPair going forward. currency to query for. High priority.

params.name: tradingPair
params.description: tradingPair to query for. Highest priority. Example Value (BTCUSD, ETHUSDT)
